title: Before the Roar / 咆哮の前

metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Tension-building baroque ambient × gothic chamber opera × restrained industrial undertone. 104 BPM, slow 4/4 with suspended feeling (no driving snare). Harpsichord sparse and echoing, low string tremolo, distant organ drones, subtle metallic ticks like cooling stone. Waterfall ambience constant but muted, as if heard through fog.

**Vocal Direction:** Alternating perspectives. Warm mezzo for the Rebel (uncertain, restrained). Bright but unstable soprano for the Queen (rising intensity, controlled tremor). Mixed choir murmurs for the Guild (measured, almost judicial). No explosive peaks—hold tension. Leave space.

**Mood:** Suspended judgment. Regret, pride, calculation. Sacred damage examined in silence.

**Structure:** Ambient Overture → Rebel Verse → Guild Interlude → Queen Verse → Ensemble Undercurrent → Final Suspended Cadence (no resolution).
metadata.prompt:
## OVERTURE — Cracked Sanctuary

*(low organ drone; distant water; falling debris echo)*

The cliffs are scarred.
The bridges sway.

Mist drifts through fractured stone.

霧はまだ落ちる。

## VERSE I — The Rebel (Mezzo)

I wanted justice—
clean and bright.

A blade to cut
through velvet night.

But look—

The pillars split.
The water choked.
The sacred arches
nearly broke.

This was not the world I meant.

証を求めた。

I summoned storm
and called it righteous—

Now I stand
in wreckage.

## INTERLUDE — The Guild (Choir, hushed)

Observe.
Measure.
Preserve.

System above spectacle.
Continuity above pride.

天上ギルド
静かに議す。

## VERSE II — The Queen (Soprano, growing intensity)

They watched me rise—
and called it threat.

They envied flame
and now regret.

Is it my fault
that I burn bright?

Is it my sin
that I claim height?

The world bends small
beneath my gaze.

If stone has cracked,
it’s stone that strays.

*(tone sharpens)*

I was ordained
by force of will—

If heaven trembles,
I reign still.

## ENSEMBLE — Under the Mist

*(all voices overlapping softly, never fully colliding)*

Rebel (low):
I did not mean for this to fall—

Guild (measured):
Stability must govern all—

Queen (ascending):
They fear the crown that I install—

Water (ambient swell):
…

## FINAL CADENCE — Edge of Decision

*(strings tremble; organ low; waterfall slightly louder)*

Three paths in fractured air.

One system trembling.

One will rising.

One conscience breaking.

咆哮の前。

息。
